executive_summary: Recent CISA KEV and GitHub advisories expose critical flaws in GitLab, JFrog Artifactory, MikroTik, Chromium, and N‑able, providing practical material for defensive security study and portfolio projects.

signals.title: GitLab repository commits API path traversal
signals.what_changed: CVE-2026-85706 published indicating unauthenticated path traversal in commits API
signals.why_it_matters: Allows reading arbitrary repository files without authentication, threatening source code confidentiality
signals.application: Deploy GitLab CE, craft request with '..' in path, verify unauthorized file read, then implement path sanitization

signals.title: JFrog Artifactory token scope validation flaw
signals.what_changed: CVE-2026-42016 published showing token validation ignores scope
signals.why_it_matters: Enables privilege escalation in CI/CD pipelines by bypassing scope checks
signals.application: Run local Artifactory, test token without scope, demonstrate escalation, then enforce scope validation

signals.title: MikroTik RouterOS argument delimiter neutralization
signals.what_changed: CVE-2026-86060 published revealing improper argument delimiter handling
signals.why_it_matters: Allows attacker to change router policy mask and gain privilege escalation
signals.application: Use MikroTik virtual lab, inject delimiter in command, observe policy change, then apply input sanitization

signals.title: Chromium V8 out-of-bounds write
signals.what_changed: CVE-2026-87491 published for out-of-bounds write in V8 engine
signals.why_it_matters: Enables remote code execution via crafted HTML, affecting many browsers
signals.application: Create malicious HTML page, test code execution in Chromium, then add input validation and sandbox checks

signals.title: N-able N-central static code injection
signals.what_changed: CVE-2026-86218 published indicating pre‑auth remote code execution
signals.why_it_matters: Allows attacker to execute code before authentication in SaaS management platform
signals.application: Run N-central container, attempt exploit via crafted request, then implement input filtering and auth checks

experiment.title: Reproduce GitLab Path Traversal CVE-2026-85706
experiment.objective: Show that unauthenticated requests can read arbitrary repository files via the commits API
steps: Start GitLab CE container exposing port 8080
Create a test project with a file path containing '..' characters
Send GET request to /api/v4/projects/:id/repository/commits with malicious path parameter
Observe response containing file contents without authentication
experiment.stop_condition: When file content is successfully retrieved without authentication

discarded: All CISA KEV entries beyond the five selected signals
